judge.voice: Víte, it was gentle and Lena spoke slowly, which I liked. When I did not know what to say, the help was easy to find and I did not leave the room. The choice of two phrases was clear. But the help sometimes gave me the wrong sentence, "I see you" when I wanted to ask about school, and then I just copied it. I wanted to say something about my garden. Then it finished while Lena asked about painting, and nobody told me what I said well or badly. No note, no second try. I like that it says honestly I had help, not alone. For Saturday before the call I would use it again, but I need the words for my grandchildren, and a real second chance to try.
